research_findings.rust_auto_ml_pipeline_patterns_2026: Modern closed-loop auto-ML pipelines in Rust focus heavily on resource efficiency, type-safe hyperparameter specification, and isolated execution states. Systems utilize transaction-rollback or virtual workspaces to test configurations without contaminating production data. Serialized progress and states allow deterministic replay and configuration hot-reloading.
research_findings.closed_loop_benchmark_regression_testing: Closed-loop performance regression gates require statistical significance constraints (e.g. Mann-Whitney U test or Wilcoxon signed-rank) to filter out baseline drift. In addition, multi-metric balancing ensures that optimizing for latency doesn't degrade accuracy (Recall@K).
research_findings.recall_k_evaluation_harness_best_practic: Harnesses for Recall@K and MRR should maintain independent golden test cases representing production query patterns. Dynamic recall-threshold gating is combined with budget auto-tuning where retrieval limits scale adaptively based on target latency constraints.
research_findings.cargo_bench_criterion_auto_benchmarking: Criterion's statistics engine is used to automatically capture execution estimates (via standard JSON exports) and perform automated drift detection in CI/CD, enabling systems to reject proposed adjustments that do not show a statistically significant improvement.

phase_2_requirements.hyperparameter_search_strategies: Incorporate automated Bayesian Optimization (e.g., Tree-structured Parzen Estimator) or genetic algorithms to traverse hyperparameter grids efficiently rather than relying purely on static grid searches.
phase_2_requirements.statistical_significance_validation: Replace simple threshold and epsilon checks with statistical significance testing (t-test or Wilcoxon) over multiple benchmark iterations to prevent accepting noise-driven improvements.
phase_2_requirements.real_time_drift_remediation: Integrate the AutoImprovementEngine with the scheduler daemon so that upon drift detection, the RRF weight tuner automatically triggers and attempts self-healing without requiring operator intervention.
phase_2_requirements.multi_dimensional_pareto_front: Maintain a Pareto front balancing Recall@K, Precision@K, and Latency (p99) to let operators choose between 'maximum accuracy' or 'minimum latency' profiles.
